title: How Inmates Eat, Shower & Sleep in America's Only Federal Supermax
intro: ADX Florence in Colorado is America's only federal supermax. The bed is concrete, the window is four inches wide, and most men spend at least 22 hours a day alone in a 7-by-12-foot cell. Here's how they eat, shower and sleep.
asof_line: Figures come from the DC Corrections Information Council inspection (visit April 2017, report October 2018) unless noted.
